newcode='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    # The colored junctions define the active sub-grid; plain outer margins are discarded.
    line_color = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in hr for c in vc).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(r, c) for r in hr for c in vc if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if marked:
        rlo, rhi = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
        clo, chi = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)
        hr = [r for r in hr if rlo <= r <= rhi]
        vc = [c for c in vc if clo <= c <= chi]
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(hr, hr[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(vc, vc[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            row.append(vals[0] if all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] != background]
    # The colored junctions define the active sub-grid; plain outer margins are discarded.
    line_color = Counter(Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] for r in hr).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = [(r, c) for r in hr for c in vc if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if marked:
        rlo, rhi = min(r for r, c in marked), max(r for r, c in marked)
        clo, chi = min(c for r, c in marked), max(c for r, c in marked)
        hr = [r for r in hr if rlo <= r <= rhi]
        vc = [c for c in vc if clo <= c <= chi]
    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(hr, hr[1:]):
        row = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(vc, vc[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2])
            row.append(vals[0] if all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
